en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a scenic riverside cityscape. A bridge (Radetzkybrücke) crosses a river with horse-drawn carriages on it, and grand 19th-century buildings line the waterfront. In the background, a steep hill (Schlossberg) rises, topped by a fortress and the iconic clock tower of Graz. The foreground features tree-lined promenades and early 20th-century street life. The card is captioned in German and bears a postmark dated 1903.
